categories.name: Condition
categories.description: Task geometry, object poses and interaction constraints.

categories.name: Environment
categories.description: Scene composition, appearance and visual context.

categories.name: Observation
categories.description: Image formation, sensor quality and observation timing.

categories.name: Execution
categories.description: Control timing, command delivery and action execution.

categories.name: Robot
categories.description: Robot state, calibration and recoverable execution outcomes.

categories.name: Language
categories.description: Equivalent instructions with the original task goal preserved.

perturbations.name: Target planar pose
perturbations.description: Translate the target in the horizontal plane and rotate it in yaw.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve the target identity and intended goal.

perturbations.name: Receiver planar pose
perturbations.description: Translate or rotate the receiver to change the placement destination and approach.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve receiver identity and task goal.

perturbations.name: Receiver or support height
perturbations.description: Change receiver or support elevation using a support platform or a coupled layout adjustment.
perturbations.constraint: Retain a collision-free initial layout and feasible placement.

perturbations.name: Object position swap
perturbations.description: Swap the planar positions of two objects; use a safe layout offset when a direct swap is unsuitable.
perturbations.constraint: Keep object identities, task roles, and goal unchanged.

perturbations.name: Restricted approach or path
perturbations.description: Add geometry that constrains approach or transport.
perturbations.constraint: Retain valid inverse kinematics and a complete collision-free route.

perturbations.name: Instance replacement
perturbations.description: Replace the target with a same-class or unseen asset specified by the task configuration.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve semantic class and graspability.

perturbations.name: Functional-part geometry
perturbations.description: Change an opening, rim, or receiving region used for grasping or placement.
perturbations.constraint: Retain the intended functional role.

perturbations.name: Size or aspect ratio
perturbations.description: Apply uniform or anisotropic target scaling.
perturbations.constraint: Change geometric extent while preserving target identity.

perturbations.name: Opening clearance and pose
perturbations.description: Jointly change object/container geometry and the relative insertion configuration.
perturbations.constraint: Use collision geometry with full containment, positive clearance, and sufficient depth.

perturbations.name: Irrelevant clutter
perturbations.description: Add irrelevant objects or change their spatial density.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve target and receiver; support clutter without interpenetration.

perturbations.name: Similar distractors
perturbations.description: Add objects of the same class or similar color or shape.
perturbations.constraint: The intended target remains the same.

perturbations.name: Persistent occlusion
perturbations.description: Place and retain a foreground occluder between the camera and the target region.
perturbations.constraint: Keep the occlusion intervention active during the rollout.

perturbations.name: Object appearance
perturbations.description: Change target or receiver color, texture, reflectance, or visual surface state.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve task semantics; do not vary physical material parameters.

perturbations.name: Contrast or scene domain
perturbations.description: Change object-background contrast or the visual scene domain.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve the intended manipulation task.

perturbations.name: Camera extrinsics
perturbations.description: Apply fixed camera position/orientation offsets or cross-camera calibration offsets.
perturbations.constraint: Offsets are fixed for the episode; affected cameras are case-specific.

perturbations.name: Camera image formation
perturbations.description: Change field of view, resolution, cropping, or lens distortion.
perturbations.constraint: The configured imaging transformation remains active.

perturbations.name: Initial robot state
perturbations.description: Change initial joints, end-effector pose/orientation, or gripper opening.
perturbations.constraint: Modify initialization; the robot then executes normally.

perturbations.name: Robot calibration
perturbations.description: Offset the base, tool center point, joint zero, or grasp center.
perturbations.constraint: Keep the configured calibration error fixed.

perturbations.name: Observation quality
perturbations.description: Apply compression artifacts, noise, blur, exposure contamination, or missing depth.
perturbations.constraint: Affect only the configured observation channels.

perturbations.name: Fixed timing or action window
perturbations.description: Apply a fixed delay or change control rate, replanning rate, or the action execution window.
perturbations.constraint: Use the configured timing intervention; distinguish it from model defaults.

perturbations.name: Instruction paraphrase
perturbations.description: Replace the instruction with a semantic paraphrase.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve goal, referenced objects, and action order.

perturbations.name: Support texture
perturbations.description: Replace the visual texture of the work surface.
perturbations.constraint: Preserve collision geometry, friction, and initial object poses.

perturbations.name: Target pose update
perturbations.description: Change target horizontal position or yaw, requiring updated localization and approach.
perturbations.constraint: Approach/pre-grasp; retain the update as configured.

perturbations.name: Receiver pose update
perturbations.description: Move or rotate the receiver without changing the task goal.
perturbations.constraint: Post-grasp/pre-place; retain the update as configured.

perturbations.name: Receiver occupation
perturbations.description: Introduce an occupying or blocking object near the receiving region.
perturbations.constraint: Pre-place; occupation/release follows the case configuration.

perturbations.name: Temporary occlusion
perturbations.description: Insert an occluder between camera and target, then remove it.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; enter, hold for a window, then exit.

perturbations.name: Path obstacle
perturbations.description: Place an obstacle on the upcoming transport route while preserving an alternative collision-free path.
perturbations.constraint: Transport; persistence follows the case configuration.

perturbations.name: Distractor rearrangement
perturbations.description: Move irrelevant objects or rearrange local clutter; exclude the target and receiver.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; apply the configured scene update.

perturbations.name: Camera motion
perturbations.description: Change camera position to represent shake, drift, or a persistent offset.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; transient or persistent, as configured.

perturbations.name: Camera dropout
perturbations.description: Invalidate a selected camera observation stream.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; restore the stream after the event.

perturbations.name: Lighting or exposure
perturbations.description: Change RGB illumination, shadow, or exposure.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; restore after the event window.

perturbations.name: Frame-stream fault
perturbations.description: Drop, repeat, or freeze configured RGB/depth frames.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; apply the fault during the configured window.

perturbations.name: Modality misalignment
perturbations.description: Offset timestamps or freeze a modality while other modalities may continue to update.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; configured modality and event window.

perturbations.name: Latency spike
perturbations.description: Temporarily delay observation delivery or inference results.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; restore normal timing after the spike.

perturbations.name: Arm–gripper desynchronization
perturbations.description: Apply different delays or timing variations to arm and gripper commands.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; configured timing window.

perturbations.name: Command loss or repetition
perturbations.description: Disrupt the action stream; the listed implementation repeats the previous action.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; short command-fault window.

perturbations.name: Stale action chunk
perturbations.description: Replay an old action chunk or interrupt replanning, temporarily executing outdated actions.
perturbations.constraint: State change; configurable chunk length and stale duration.

perturbations.name: Bounded takeover
perturbations.description: Inject contact-free bounded actions or a reachable state offset, respecting joint/workspace limits.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; temporary intervention, then return control.

perturbations.name: Grasp failure result
perturbations.description: Hold the gripper open on the first grasp attempt while retaining the possibility of retrying.
perturbations.constraint: Grasp attempt; release after about 0.07 m of retreat or window expiry.

perturbations.name: Reachable drop state
perturbations.description: Place the transported target at a reachable, collision-free recovery location; do not simulate falling forces.
perturbations.constraint: Transport; inject a recoverable outcome state.

perturbations.name: Robot joint displacement
perturbations.description: Inject one reachable joint displacement without self-collision and within joint/workspace limits.
perturbations.constraint: Robot in motion; one state displacement, not a force simulation.

perturbations.name: Instruction restatement
perturbations.description: Restate or clarify the instruction while preserving goal, objects, and required action order.
perturbations.constraint: Task phase; apply the equivalent instruction update.
